attach_align_device_hook: attach AlignDevicesHook to all submodules of a model with optional offloading and execution device configuration
add_hook_to_module: add a ModelHook to a PyTorch module to intercept and modify its forward pass behavior
attach_align_device_hook_on_blocks: attach AlignDevicesHook to model blocks with per-block execution device and offload configuration
remove_hook_from_module: remove a ModelHook from a PyTorch module and restore its original forward method
layerwise_casting_hook: cast module weights between storage and compute dtypes to reduce memory footprint during inference
